description: List Carragent's plans with monthly and yearly prices in USD cents (plus applicable taxes), their limits, the free-trial length and the refund terms. Use it when a user asks how much Carragent costs or which plan fits. Returns { plans: [...], terms: {...} }.

lang.description: Language of the text: en, es or fr.

name: list_plans

limits.description: Each limit, or null when there is none.

monthlyCents.description: The monthly price in US cents; for custom, the from price.

selfServe.description: Whether the owner can sign up for it alone on carragent.com.

yearlyCents.description: The yearly price in US cents, or null.

title: List Carragent's plans and prices
